''See also: [[Shera Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shera is a formidable figure known by several titles, including the [[Knife]] and the The Killer{{!}}Killer. As one of the [[Am’haranai]], she is a double [[Soulbound]] who has bound her soul to an ancient weapon created from the [[Emperor's power]]. Her unique nature allows her to act as a bridge between the Emperor and other powers, having even absorbed the essence of a destroyed [[Handmaiden]]. This connection makes her an exceptionally dangerous individual, regarded by some as the greatest threat to the future of humanity. Physically, Shera is characterized by her short black hair and a tendency to The mask{{!}}mask the lower half of her face with gray or [[black cloth]]. She is a highly skilled combatant, proficient with bronze knives, daggers, poisoned [[needles]], and [[shears]]. Her fighting style is marked by agility and stealth, often involving sudden appearances or leaping from heights to attack targets. Throughout her history, Shera has worked with the Emperor and fought against the [[Children of Nakothi]]. Her motivations are complex; while she has attempted to assassinate various figures such as Naberius Clayborn{{!}}Naberius and Urzaia Woodsman{{!}}Urzaia, her actions often appear tied to larger objectives. She has expressed a lack of desire for eternal life or the influence of the [[Elders]] and the Emperor, instead seeking to understand the purpose behind such things. Despite her capacity for intense bloodlust and coldness in combat, she has also shown moments of vulnerability and inquiry regarding the meaning of her struggles.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Shera is a blond woman with short black hair, bright orange eyes featuring vertical slit pupils, and ice-cold eyes described as being as dead as a snake's or a shark's. She often wears gray hooded clothing and a cloth The mask{{!}}mask that covers her nose and mouth, though she has also been seen in black [[Gardener]] attire. Her physical condition has included a missing right ear, various gunshot wounds, and severe burns.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Described as lazy, unpredictable, and possessing a mentality of pure chaos, Shera can become dark and cold, causing her familiar persona to disappear. She is a professional [[assassin]] and [[Consultant]] who has served The Empire{{!}}the Empire and now acts as an Independent [[Guild]] leader. While she is a significant threat to others, she is also an ally of [[Lucan]] and has taken on the responsibilities of a Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As a double [[Soulbound]], Shera can steal power from [[Elderspawn]] to create green wisps or channel life absorbed from her twin [[Vessels]]. She utilizes the power of [[Bastion]] to see through the [[Veil]], compress [[silver mist]], and create cages of [[Soulbound]] [[Intent]] using golden light and thorny vines. Her combat skills involve the use of [[spades]], poisoned [[needles]], gas [[bombs]], alchemy flares, and various blades, including her [[Awakened weapons]] [[Syphren]] and her invested [[shears]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Life in the Capital}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Originally a beggar on the streets, Shera was born in the underside of the Capital where she worked cleaning the city under Rudeus Maxwell{{!}}Maxwell.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 4</ref> She is a member of the [[Guild]]'s order of assassins who has since left her Workshop{{!}}workshop.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" /> Equipped with a small knife and a paralyzing needles{{!}}paralyzing needle, she also carries bronze [[shears]] in both hands, though she never draws the one on her left.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c4" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 6</ref> Having been conditioned by Rudeus Maxwell{{!}}Maxwell's attacks to respond to the slightest sounds, she has previously pulled a knife on [[Kerian]] and used a stolen blade to attack a prisoner.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" /><ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 5</ref> During the encounter with the prisoner, she seized his wrist and pushed it against his body.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c5" /> Shera is capable of using [[shears]] as a weapon and has visited a familiar clearing in the forest.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c6" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Consultant training}} ===

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|As an [[Architect]] and a member of the [[Guild]], Shera serves as an Independent [[Guild]] leader.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> After the High [[Council]] pressured her to assassinate the Emperor earlier than intended, she proved her lethality by being capable of killing Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten in various ways even without weapons.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c7">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref> While preparing to drop from a wall, she utilized the power of [[Bastion's Veil]], which allows her to see through the [[Veil]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8" /> Despite having served The Empire{{!}}the Empire, Shera's body became sick and tender, leading her to threaten a group with being drawn and quartered or receiving a thousand lashes.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c13">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 13</ref> She encouraged [[Lucan]] to free the [[Regents]] and was seen trailing behind the [[Mason]] while carrying [[Syphren]] in her left hand.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c11">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> Having been trained in the Garden, she used a [[hooded quicklamp]] for light but was ultimately wounded by gunfire in her stomach, left arm, and shoulder.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 15</ref> Missing her right ear, she wore a protective, invested gray hooded outfit and utilized the [[Soulbound]] power of [[Bastion]] to create a cage of gold light and thorny vines through [[Soulbound]] [[Intent]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c15" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 16</ref> Shera also employed [[Syphren]] and a [[gas bomb]], eventually killing [[Calder]] on behalf of the [[Guild]] while hoping for a better outcome at the Emperor's Stage.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c16" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c17">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 17</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c18">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 18</ref>}}

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Preparing for a confrontation with a [[Great Elder]], Shera manages [[Vessels]] that are subject to various urges.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" /> During the battle, she utilizes her [[Vessels]] alongside a green blade while noticing that light is emanating from [[Hightower]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> Shera channels life absorbed from her [[Vessels]] and employs [[Bastion]] to ward off the Elder's power, even compressing the [[silver mist]] of Bastion's Veil{{!}}Bastion’s Veil.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> After her body is cleansed by a golden light, she freezes just an inch from Darius Allbright{{!}}Darius' chest and grabs [[Meia]]'s head to shield her eyes from the celestial figures clashing in the void.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23" /> Following her personal act of stabbing [[Kelarac]] in the back, she questions why the [[Guild Heads]] are concerned with a man's survival.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref>}}

</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Gathering allies}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|During the mobilization of her forces, Shera and the other mortals packed their ships to capacity with as many allies as they could carry.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> She commands an army composed of the [[Soulbound]], yet she remains plagued by doubts regarding whether Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius, Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten, and Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine intended to betray her to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /> Shera is fueled by energy harvested from [[Kelarac]], which grants her the power of a [[Great Elder]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> Furthermore, she possesses twin [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] and the rest of the mortals crammed as many allies on their ships as possible.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has an army of [[Soulbound]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] wondered if Nathanael Bareius{{!}}Bareius, Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten, and Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine had planned to betray her to the [[Elders]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has energy she took from [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] possesses a [[Great Elder]]'s power inside her.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Shera]] has twin [[Vessels]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“What if Shera decides to attack us while we’re running around on our own?”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c9" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“He shot a friend of mine,” Shera said. “We were only supposed to kill people who deserved it. I thought he deserved it.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|“Protect the Empire,” he had commanded her once. “Even, if necessary, from me.”<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Consultant Shera and I have a separate account to balance,”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c16" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|“I'm getting a little tired,” she said. Then she collapsed.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c11" />}}
